# FindPort Vendor Snapshot

This directory contains a private vendor snapshot of selected files from
[`skavazza/findport`](https://github.com/skavazza/findport), exported from that
repository's staged Git index on 2026-10-24. The upstream checkout's base
commit was `c34d8e816a4d26c3dc378f6d16577a856407bcc0` (2026-10-16); the staged
snapshot also includes changes not present in that base commit.

The files below were exported as raw index blobs. Their Git object IDs are:

| File | Blob |
|---|---|
| `README.md` | `b05b878871cf60eb1970da0e3ef27f1409cd1289` |
| `REQUIREMENTS.md` | `90df2eff064b5b78e2c3b9ebf606fdb90e2cff0e` |
| `find_ports.ps1` | `4a698883ed0db32ba69a274efab83933a735a0a3` |
| `gui_bridge.ps1` | `889a10ef3665393cf1787f03d657eec00d713895` |
| `run.bat` | `d559d8e10e2e220c47170428e728ea0e3e749135` |

No `LICENSE` file was present in the exported index. The project owner
authorized this inclusion in the private ServerPy repository only. This notice
does not grant a license or permission for public redistribution. Do not
